Feature Issue #198 - Assign folders to categories in Manage Categories: any project found inside an assigned folder is automatically filed under that category, and projects already there are sorted right away
Store project identity in .godothub/project.json and version pins in .godothub/.godotrc, keeping both out of the project root. The folder is also marked as hidden on Windows.
Automatically add .gdignore inside .godothub so Godot skips its contents during asset scanning and keeps the metadata folder out of the FileSystem dock on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Automatically migrate existing .godothub.json and .godotrc files when projects load or are imported, preserving IDs, categories, version pins, and time tracking. Conflicting files or failed migrations retain the original data for recovery.

Exclude the .godothub folder and legacy metadata files when saving, importing, syncing, or copying templates and duplicating projects, so each new project gets its own identity. Clean stale metadata from managed templates and keep it out of previews.
Skip Git metadata and Godot's editor cache when creating projects from older templates, and reject overlapping copy or sync folders to protect source projects.
Keep a project's identity when installing Asset Library content: downloaded identity files no longer overwrite the destination project's marker.
Include .godothub/ when creating a new project's .gitignore, including projects whose templates already provide one. Existing ignore rules are preserved without adding duplicate entries.
Ability to downloads Export Templates for your godot versions
Project Doctor: A Tool that helps you identify what your project is missing and provides a solution if available.
Build & Export Setting So you can export your builds without opening the project
Error Popup on when the version install fails

Launch arguments are now split like a shell, so quoted paths such as --write-movie "my clip.avi" are passed as a single argument
When a project's bound Godot version isn't installed, you can download it in one click from the error instead of hitting a dead end
Error pop-ups across the app were replaced with non-blocking toast notifications
Ctrl+R now asks for confirmation before reloading, so it no longer discards unsaved input mid-form
Onboarding can import recent projects from Godot's project manager and detect existing Godot installs on PATH and in Steam libraries, letting you pick what to add
tauri:build no longer fails on a missing patch-appimage-wayland.sh step (Wayland is already handled at runtime)
Resuming an interrupted Godot download now restarts cleanly when the server ignores the resume request, instead of appending to the file and corrupting the archive
Downloaded Godot builds are now verified against the official SHA512 checksums before installing, and a failed check deletes the bad file
Godot downloads now retry automatically with exponential backoff on transient network errors
Removed the "Updates from Dev" section and the external content service (Sanity.io) behind it
Removed an unused web font download for a faster, more private startup

Installing an asset from the asset library now streams the download to disk instead of buffering it in memory, and refuses malicious archives (path traversal, symlinks, and zip bombs) during extraction

Discarding all changes no longer deletes untracked files by surprise: it now shows exactly which untracked files would be removed and lets you choose to discard tracked changes only, also remove untracked files, or stash everything instead, defaulting to the safe option

Hardened local data against loss: a corrupt project list now offers to restore from its automatic backup instead of showing an empty library, background and UI updates to your projects and time tracking can no longer overwrite each other, each data file carries a schema version for safe future migrations, and pending settings changes are saved when you close the window

Storage view: see how much space your installed Godot versions, project templates and export templates take, and reclaim space from unused versions, unfinished downloads and orphaned export templates after reviewing exactly what will be removed

Quick-add a to-do by typing its title and pressing Enter, and search or filter the full to-do list by area
Completed to-dos now remember when they were finished and are listed newest first with their completion date

Fixed C# projects failing to build or run when opened from the Linux AppImage ("Unable to load shared library libSystem.Security.Cryptography.Native.OpenSsl"): Godot, git and mise no longer inherit GodotHub's bundled libraries (#208)
Saved git credentials, git auth data and settings files are now readable only by your user account on Linux and macOS
Failing to save git credentials now shows an error instead of silently leaving git unauthenticated
Fixed the app becoming unresponsive after an internal error by making shared state recover instead of panicking
Heavy actions such as creating, importing and opening projects, templates, backups and mise checks no longer freeze the window while they run
Failures when opening folders and links, controlling downloads, clearing the console, undoing a project removal or syncing mise now show an error message instead of failing silently
Fixed the macOS "git log" terminal button mishandling project paths containing special characters

Custom engine builds: Import on the Versions page now has an Add custom build option, so an engine compiled from source (any file name) shows up in the versions list and works like an official version (#209)
Fixed the running projects menu in the titlebar opening behind the sidebar
Fixed switching Git worktrees reverting to the main worktree: the project now remembers the worktree you switched to
Fixed the delete and switch buttons in the Git worktrees list often being unclickable: the list no longer refreshes itself in a loop while Git is running
Opening the project list, checking which projects are running, stopping a project, opening a project folder and loading installed versions no longer briefly freeze the window

Having a project open in the Godot editor no longer makes GodotHub refresh Git and rescan your projects every second: changes inside .godot/, .import/ and Git's internal folders are now ignored, and automatic scans no longer overlap
The project list loads faster: project names and tags are only read again from project.godot when that file changes
Settings and workspace data are now kept in memory instead of being read from disk for every action
Saving skips the write entirely when nothing changed, and the .bak backup copy is refreshed at most once a minute instead of on every save
The Projects page no longer re-sorts and redraws every second while a project is running and you sort by time spent
Project cards only redraw when their own project changes, so large libraries are smoother to scroll, filter and select
Git status checks pause while GitHub is hidden or minimized to the tray, and the Dashboard and Projects page now share one refresh instead of each running their own
Very large diffs in the diff viewer and commit details now open and scroll smoothly

Fixed clicking a project's folder location opening the Documents folder on Windows after switching Git worktrees: worktree paths are now saved with Windows path separators, and projects already affected are repaired automatically
New Show Session Timer option in Customize View: hide the live timer that counts up next to the Open button while a project is running, separately from Show Time Tracked (#215)

Fixed the Versions page showing an outdated list of Godot releases (for example stopping at an older beta): newly published releases now appear as soon as GodotHub fetches them, and the list refreshes when you come back to the window instead of only on the next launch
